name: Natera
thesis: STUB: Natera (NTRA) is an evaluation candidate. Holdings JSON scaffolded by Phase F-3 to carry per-ticker break_rules for the eval brief — needs user-authored thesis + tier_1_kpis + DCF params if/when it graduates to portfolio.

break_rules.narrative: Revenue declining YoY for 2 consecutive quarters — outright top-line contraction.
FCF margin below 5% for 2 consecutive Qs — cash conversion broken. (Universal floor; per-ticker rules below are stricter.)
Operating cash flow declining >10% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs.

business_model_rules.narrative: Revenue YoY < 20% for 2Q — STUB; high-growth genomics platform should sustain 25%+ during product expansion.
GM < 50% for 2Q — test reagent costs + reimbursement mix deteriorating; the consumable-economics thesis fails.
Op margin < -10% for 2Q — scaling-to-breakeven path breaks; clinical genomics scale should drive toward breakeven not deeper losses.
